concepts.title: The KDD Process and the Data Mining Task Taxonomy

related.label: The Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Taxonomy

concepts.summary: The KDD process from raw data to validated knowledge, and the task taxonomy of classification, regression, clustering, association, and anomaly detection, with where this curriculum covers each one.

concepts.title: Data Preprocessing: Missing Values, Scaling, Discretization
concepts.summary: Cleaning data before mining: missing-value mechanisms and imputation, min-max and z-score scaling, discretization, and the leakage caused by fitting a preprocessing step on the whole dataset.

concepts.title: Data Warehouses, Data Marts, and OLAP
concepts.summary: Warehouses versus operational databases, star and snowflake schemas, data marts, and the OLAP operations roll-up, drill-down, slice, dice, and pivot, with a book-versus-today note on columnar cloud warehouses.

concepts.title: Similarity and Distance Measures
concepts.summary: Distance and similarity for numeric, binary, and text data: Euclidean, Manhattan, Minkowski, Jaccard, Hamming, and cosine, and why the choice and the scaling change the result.

concepts.title: k-Nearest Neighbors
concepts.summary: k-NN as lazy learning: classification and regression by neighbors, choosing k, the curse of dimensionality, and the index structures that make queries practical.

concepts.title: Frequent Itemsets and the Apriori Algorithm
concepts.summary: Itemsets and support, the anti-monotone property that prunes the search, and Apriori's level-wise candidate generation worked on a small transaction set.

concepts.title: FP-Growth
concepts.summary: Mining frequent itemsets without candidate generation: building the FP-tree, mining conditional pattern bases, and when this beats Apriori.

concepts.title: Association Rules: Support, Confidence, Lift
concepts.summary: From frequent itemsets to rules: support, confidence, and lift, and why high confidence alone can mislead.

concepts.title: Hierarchical Clustering
concepts.summary: Agglomerative and divisive clustering, single, complete, average, and Ward linkage, reading a dendrogram, and how this differs from k-means.

concepts.title: Density-Based Clustering with DBSCAN
concepts.summary: DBSCAN's core, border, and noise points, density reachability, choosing eps and minPts, and clusters of arbitrary shape.

concepts.title: Cluster Validation
concepts.summary: Internal and external validation with silhouette, Davies-Bouldin, and the adjusted Rand index, choosing the number of clusters, and when these metrics mislead.

concepts.title: Outlier Detection: Quartiles, Distance-Based, Density-Based
concepts.summary: Outliers by the interquartile range, by distance, and by local density with LOF, and how to decide whether an outlier is an error or the finding.

concepts.title: Text Mining: Bag of Words and TF-IDF
concepts.summary: Turning text into vectors: tokenization, stop words, stemming, bag of words, TF-IDF weighting, and cosine similarity between documents.

concepts.title: A Text Clustering Pipeline End to End
concepts.summary: A worked pipeline from raw documents through TF-IDF, dimensionality reduction, clustering, and evaluation, ending with reading the top terms of each cluster.

concepts.title: Mining at Scale: From MapReduce to Spark

related.label: MapReduce Fault Tolerance, Locality, and Stragglers

concepts.summary: What changes when patterns and clusters no longer fit in memory: MapReduce rounds, Spark's in-memory model, and parallel frequent-pattern mining and k-means. Mahout appears only as a book-versus-today note.

concepts.title: Choosing a Mining Technique: A Decision Guide

related.label: Choosing and Validating a Model: A Decision Guide

concepts.summary: A decision guide for the whole discipline: given the data and the question, choose a mining task and a technique, and name what would invalidate the result.
